name: Wormwood
overview: The Bible uses wormwood as a powerful symbol of bitterness and judgment. It is described as a bitter plant associated with gall, representing the consequences of turning away from God and embracing sin, as seen in Deuteronomy 29:18 and Jeremiah 9:15. Wormwood also figuratively illustrates the painful outcomes of folly and unfaithfulness, such as the bitter end of the adulterous woman in Proverbs 5:4 and the judgment upon false prophets in Jeremiah 23:15. Lamentations 3:19 further emphasizes wormwood as a metaphor for affliction and misery experienced under God's discipline.
